column2: Paula, a 45-year-old Brazilian HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, and Jorge, a 52-year-old Brazilian hardware store owner with gray mustache and work apron, side by side at an office desk in front of a laptop, checking together a handwritten task list on paper

Paula, 45-year-old Brazilian HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, at her home office desk, opening a well-organized folder of documents on her laptop, paper folders with colored tabs on the desk beside her
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, writing a short list of house rules on a sheet of paper next to her laptop, a sticky note on the laptop edge, calm morning light

Jorge, 52-year-old Brazilian hardware store owner with gray mustache and work apron, at the store counter watching his laptop screen attentively, the screen shows blurred steps appearing one after another, shelves of tools behind him
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, drawing a finish-line checklist on a notepad with three boxes ticked, laptop open beside her, coffee mug

Jorge, 52-year-old hardware store owner with gray mustache, walking on a sidewalk outside his store holding his smartphone and looking at it, through the store window a laptop is visible open on the counter
Jorge, 52-year-old hardware store owner with gray mustache and apron, holding two printed copies of the same price catalog, one in each hand, comparing them at his counter, laptop open
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, opening a desk drawer full of neatly labeled index cards, the laptop on the desk, organized home office
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, choosing between three different pens laid out on her desk before writing, laptop open, thoughtful expression
Jorge, 52-year-old hardware store owner with gray mustache, adjusting the knob of an old radio on the store counter while looking at his laptop, relaxed afternoon
Jorge, 52-year-old hardware store owner with gray mustache and apron, handing a set of keys to a young employee at the store counter, explaining with a gesture which doors they open, laptop nearby
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, in a small kitchen at home, reading a handwritten recipe card while cooking pancakes, laptop open on the kitchen table
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, packing neatly organized folders into a travel suitcase at home, laptop open beside the suitcase
Jorge, 52-year-old hardware store owner with gray mustache, connecting cables between his laptop and a printer and a phone on the store counter, focused
Paula, 45-year-old HR consultant with short brown hair and glasses, sitting back with arms crossed watching her laptop where a web page is being filled in by itself, blurred screen shapes, calm

Jorge, 52-year-old hardware store owner with gray mustache, arriving at his store early in the morning, finding a neatly printed report waiting on the counter next to the laptop, a wall clock showing early morning
